headline: Is a real connection coming, or do I stay alone?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/writeups/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing LONELINESS_TAROT_HOOKS frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. You couldn't see him, but your hand found the one with a complete table.
Every tool is laid out and ready in front of him.
You asked whether a real connection is coming or you stay alone. The complete table is the part I notice first.
No connection has come, and staying alone is the other answer in your question.
I keep coming back to something between your full capacity and connection. I don't think it began with you.
Now let me look at what's behind this…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. The card was hidden, yet you chose the one with life around the pause.
Green leaves grow from the wood above the still figure.
You asked whether the pause ends in connection. This card makes me look at the living leaves.
Still, you are alone, and the pause feels as though it may decide the future.
Something has hold of the relationship question and keeps it quiet. I don't think this began with you.
Let me see what's holding this…
c: You turned the Fool. Nothing on the backs showed it, but your hand went to the open road.
The road begins beneath a full, clear sun.
You asked whether someone is coming. The open road is where this card takes me.
But no one is on the road with you, and staying alone is the other answer in your question.
Something appears just where the road would become shared. I don't think it started with you.
Now let's look at what's behind it…
